description:
Synthesize a new POMO-based solver for the **Capacitated Vehicle Routing
Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW)**, by *modifying the input, state and
masking* of the existing POMO CVRP implementation -- not by rewriting its
neural backbone.

The seed code (the `pomo/` baseline staged into your worktree) solves plain
CVRP: it samples coordinates and demands, then rolls out POMO's RNN
encoder-decoder with a `visited` mask and a capacity mask. CVRPTW adds a
constraint on *when* each customer may be served, which forces:

  1. two new per-instance tensors: `time_windows` (n+1, 2) and
     `service_times` (n+1,);
  2. one new per-step dynamic state: `current_time` (batch, pomo);
  3. a new masking layer: a customer is masked when it is already visited,
     when serving it would exceed capacity, or when it cannot be served
     inside its time window given the arrival time;
  4. a replacement of the capacity-only masking rule with a rule that also
     carries a "return-to-depot is always allowed for feasibility" exception.

The checkpoint becomes available in your worktree as the path named by
`problem.yaml:resources.checkpoint`. It was trained by POMO on CVRP100, and
the synthesized solver must keep it loadable: the encoder's input dimension
stays unchanged, and any new information enters the decoder as an additional
concatenated feature.
tips:
- Time is defined by Euclidean distance (travel time == distance). Do NOT
  introduce a vehicle speed.
- Customers may be served at or after their window opens; arriving early is
  allowed and the vehicle waits. Arriving after the window closes is infeasible.
- A vehicle may always return to the depot; returning early simply starts a
  new route, and it costs the depot round trip.
- Service times accumulate onto the current time. Waiting accumulates too.
- The acceptance contract of the whole pipeline is textual: the generated
  program must print both lines listed under `program.expected_lines` in
  `problems/cvrptw/problem.yaml`, on stdout.
- Instances are synthesized locally (n=20). Nobody supplies a dataset.
